card.name: Inside fungal and microbe names
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of long, split-up names of fungi, bacteria, parasites and rare syndromes, such as cryptococcosis, histoplasmosis, Pseudomonas and schistosomiasis. It fires partway through the name, before the ending.
